security_audit.summary: Reviewed all 39 static findings in SKILL.md. The external command, network, sensitive, and reconnaissance alerts are false positives from Markdown fences, example validation snippets, field names, and report formatting. One low privacy concern remains because report examples can include raw invalid samples from user data.

remediation.issue: Validation reports may include raw samples from user data.
remediation.suggestion: Mask, truncate, or hash sample values before adding them to reports, especially for email, phone, URL, and duplicate record fields.

semantic_findings.title: Validation Reports May Include Raw Data Samples
semantic_findings.description: The examples include invalid sample values and duplicate rows in reports. Shared reports could expose personal data from email, phone, URL, or duplicate records.

content.user_title: Validate Data Quality and Business Rules
content.value_statement: Bad records, weak schemas, and unclear rules can slow delivery and hide data quality risks. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through validation checks, reports, and practical fixes.
actual_capabilities: Validates JSON objects against JSON Schema and returns detailed field errors.
Shows AJV-based JavaScript validation for API payloads.
Checks DataFrame columns, types, nulls, uniqueness, ranges, and patterns.
Applies custom business rules through named validator functions.
Calculates completeness, duplicate counts, outliers, and quality scores.
Builds Markdown validation reports with statistics and fix context.
limitations: Provides guidance and reusable examples, not a packaged command-line tool.
Requires users to supply schemas, rules, and representative test data.
Examples depend on libraries such as jsonschema, pandas, AJV, and SciPy.
Reports may expose sensitive samples unless users mask values first.

use_cases.title: Profile Pipeline Data Quality
use_cases.description: Check incoming tables for missing values, duplicates, bad formats, and schema drift before downstream processing.

use_cases.title: Validate API Payloads
use_cases.description: Create JSON Schema or AJV checks for request and response bodies before integration testing.

use_cases.title: Audit Business Rules
use_cases.description: Translate product rules into validation checks for orders, registrations, eligibility, or compliance workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Validate a JSON Record
prompt_templates.prompt: Validate this record against the schema I provide. List each failed field, the rule it failed, and the suggested correction.

prompt_templates.title: Check a DataFrame Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this table profile and expected schema. Identify missing columns, extra columns, type mismatches, null issues, duplicates, and range violations.

prompt_templates.title: Design Business Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these business requirements into validation rules. Separate schema checks, semantic checks, cross-field checks, and user-facing error messages.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Quality Report Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a validation report plan for this dataset. Include completeness, uniqueness, validity, outliers, severity levels, and safe sample redaction rules.

output_examples.input: A customer table has required email and age fields, but some rows are missing values or contain invalid formats.
output_examples.output: The report flags missing emails, invalid email formats, and ages outside the accepted range. It also summarizes affected columns and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: An order payload must match subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, and final total rules.
output_examples.output: The validation result separates schema errors from business-rule errors. It explains which total check failed and which values need review.

output_examples.input: A data quality review needs completeness, duplicates, format checks, and an overall score.
output_examples.output: The generated report includes a summary score, column-level completeness, duplicate counts, invalid format counts, and prioritized cleanup actions.

best_practices: Define schemas and business rules before validating production data.
Mask personal data before adding sample values to shared reports.
Test validation rules with valid records, invalid records, and edge cases.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on format checks as the only business-rule validation.
Do not run untrusted custom validator functions without review.
Do not publish raw invalid samples from sensitive datasets.

faq.question: Does this skill install a validator tool?
faq.answer: No. It provides validation guidance, reusable examples, and report structures that users adapt to their environment.

faq.question: Can it validate JSON API payloads?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes JSON Schema and AJV patterns for request and response validation.

faq.question: Can it check CSV or table data?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use DataFrame checks for columns, types, nulls, duplicates, ranges, and patterns.

faq.question: Does it create business-rule validations?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows how to define named rules with clear error messages and cross-field checks.

faq.question: Can it generate data quality reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines reports with completeness, duplicates, schema errors, format errors, and quality scores.

faq.question: How should sensitive data be handled?
faq.answer: Mask or remove personal values before sharing reports, especially invalid samples and duplicate record examples.
